record_title: Exact additive lengths of the norm-one torus in every odd characteristic
provenance: An odd-characteristic extension of the additive norm-one torus decomposition problem arising in recent Gashkov-Sidelnikov decoding work, proved by a discriminant classification and a two-to-one norm-fiber argument.
limitations: The theorem concerns the full unweighted norm-one torus in a quadratic finite-field extension. It does not automatically yield decoders for arbitrary odd-characteristic codes, does not address higher-dimensional tori or higher extension degree, and has material near-simultaneous/folklore priority risk because the motivating preprint is recent and the proof is short.
